topology_checks.detail: Each connected catalog pin belongs to one net and an existing component.
TLV62569 DBV pin identities must match the manufacturer table, p3.
EN/VIN use VBUS; SW feeds the inductor; FB reads the divider, p3.
SW must not masquerade as a verified fixed DC regulator output.
A 2.2 uH inductor connects the sole SW pin to 3V3; no direct SW-to-rail join.
Required local 4.7 uF input and 10 uF output capacitor connectivity, pp8-10.
453 kohm upper / 100 kohm lower divider with no additional FB connection, p18.
Retained authored 100 nF local plus 22 uF bulk; proximity and effective C unknown.
The authored module enable uses 10 kohm / 1 uF; actual reset timing remains unknown.
BME280 supplies, CSB, data and clock remain on their authored low-voltage domains.
Each low-side signal has its 4.7 kohm pull-up to 3V3, never VBUS.
No resistor bypasses translation or adds a high-voltage pull-up to a low-side signal.
CC1 and CC2 each retain a separate 5.1 kohm Rd to ground; no current contract inferred.
USB-C carries power only; USB data and SBU pins are not repurposed as I2C.
Only VBUS is external; its current entitlement remains unspecified, not 2 A.
This design assumes 4.75-5.25 V input within IC limits; source behavior is untested.
The base variant does not silently include an external 5 V bus.

remaining_checks.reason: No advertised-source-current detection or negotiated contract.
Switching stability, startup, ripple and ESP32 load steps untested.
Temperature rise, switching-node emissions and radio coupling untested.
Net connectivity does not prove placement, routing or antenna clearance.
Actual resistor tolerances and MLCC bias/temperature capacitance unverified.
Converter 2 A rating is not a verified board or USB current budget.
Web/manual source review is not deterministic source relocation.

limitations: Placement checks use conservative component/pad envelopes. Copper clearance and connectivity require the independent routing verifier and KiCad DRC.
An antenna keepout check establishes geometric exclusion only; RF performance and the adequacy of an ASSUMED clearance policy are not verified.

limits: These are authored length/layer limits, not manufacturer-qualified routing rules.
Input/ground hot-loop area and return-plane impedance are not established by these checks.
Switching stability, ripple, efficiency, thermal capacity and EMC remain unverified.

limitations: A candidate design, not a manufacturing release or hardware-tested board.
Scoped topology arithmetic does not establish startup, stability, EMI or temperature.
USB input-current entitlement and complete worst-case load budget require review.
Exact model-to-footprint physical fits remain separate from board DRC.
ESP32-WROOM-32 footprint versus the 32E module remains an unresolved manufacturing fit, including the thermal pad and antenna geometry.
The inherited hand-solderable requirement conflicts with the BME280 LGA package; assembly method needs resolution.
